name: ctx
description: Fast local search and 'git blame' for agent sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Fast local search and 'git blame' for agent sessions.
interface.longDescription: ctx searches messages and tool calls in your past agent sessions. Its included blame command traces a line, file, commit, or PR back to the original agent session, with citations.
defaultPrompt: Search my past agent sessions for context relevant to this task.
Use ctx blame to find the agent session that produced this code.
